slides.texte_overlay:
୨୧ habits that make you
smarter naturally

1. sleep enough

deep sleep is when your brain
files what you learned.

2. learn an instrument

it trains memory, hearing
and coordination at once.

3. walk every day

movement brings more
oxygen to your brain.

4. do crosswords or sudoku

they train logic and memory.

5. learn a new language

it teaches your brain
to switch and adapt.

6. have good conversation

know a little about what's
happening in the world.
